name: garden-planner
description: 2D garden planner with material calculation (single user, self-hosted)

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n web,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck:e2e
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
